options.name: arguments
options.description: extra arguments for queue. If defined this argument is a key/value dictionary Arguments here take precedence over parameters. If both are defined, the argument will be used.

options.name: auto_delete
options.description: if the queue should delete itself after all queues/queues unbound from it.

options.name: auto_expires
options.description: How long a queue can be unused before it is automatically deleted (milliseconds).

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: CA certificate to verify SSL connection to management API.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate to send on SSL connections to management API.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Private key matching the client certificate.

options.name: dead_letter_exchange
options.description: Optional name of an exchange to which messages will be republished if they are rejected or expire.

options.name: dead_letter_routing_key
options.description: Optional replacement routing key to use when a message is dead-lettered. Original routing key will be used if unset.

options.name: durable
options.description: whether queue is durable or not.

options.name: login_host
options.description: RabbitMQ host for connection.

options.name: login_password
options.description: RabbitMQ password for connection.

options.name: login_port
options.description: RabbitMQ management API port.

options.name: login_protocol
options.description: RabbitMQ management API protocol.

options.name: login_user
options.description: RabbitMQ user for connection.

options.name: max_length
options.description: How many messages can the queue contain before it starts rejecting.

options.name: max_priority
options.description: Maximum number of priority levels for the queue to support. If not set, the queue will not support message priorities. Larger numbers indicate higher priority.

options.name: message_ttl
options.description: How long a message can live in queue before it is discarded (milliseconds).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the queue.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the queue should be present or absent.

options.name: vhost
options.description: RabbitMQ virtual host.
